duel.title: DUEL
duel.desc: A target player discards a BANG!, then you, etc. First player failing to discard a BANG! loses 1 life point.

dynamite.title: DYNAMITE
dynamite.desc: Lose 3 life points. Else pass the Dynamite on your left.

general_store.title: GENERAL STORE
general_store.desc: Reveal as many cards as players. Each player draws one.

indians.title: INDIANS!
indians.desc: All other players discard a BANG! or lose 1 life point.

jail.title: JAIL
jail.desc: Discard the jail, play normally. Else discard the jail and skip your turn.

volcanic.title: VOLCANIC
volcanic.desc: You can play any number of BANG!, but at distance 1.

bart_cassidy.title: BART CASSIDY
bart_cassidy.desc: Each time he is hit, he draws a card.

black_jack.title: BLACK JACK
black_jack.desc: He shows the second card he draws. On Heart or Diamonds he draws one more card.

calamity_janet.title: CALAMITY JANET
calamity_janet.desc: She can play BANG! cards as Missed! cards and vice versa.

el_gringo.title: EL CRINGO
el_gringo.desc: Each time he is hit by a player, he draws a card from the hand of that player.

jesse_jones.title: JESSE JONES
jesse_jones.desc: He may draw his first card from the hand of a player.

jourdonnais.title: JOURDONNAIS
jourdonnais.desc: Whenever he is the target of a BANG!, he may "draw!": on a Heart, he is missed.

kit_carlson.title: KIT CARLSON
kit_carlson.desc: He looks at the top three cards of the deck and chooses the 2 to draw.

lucky_duke.title: LUCKY DUKE
lucky_duke.desc: Each time he "draws!", he flips the top two cards and chooses one.

paul_regret.title: PAUL REGRET
paul_regret.desc: All players see him at a distance increased by 1.

pedro_ramirez.title: PEDRO RAMIREZ
pedro_ramirez.desc: He may draw his first card from the discard pile.

rose_doolan.title: ROSE DOOLAN
rose_doolan.desc: She sees all players at a distance decreased by 1.

sid_ketchum.title: SID KETCHUM
sid_ketchum.desc: He may discard 2 cards to regain one life point.

slab_the_killer.title: SLAB THE KILLER
slab_the_killer.desc: Player needs 2 Missed! cards to cancel his BANG! card.

suzy_lafayette.title: SUZE LAFAYETTE
suzy_lafayette.desc: As soon as she has no cards in hand, she draws a card.

vulture_sam.title: VULTURE SAM
vulture_sam.desc: Whenever a player is eliminated from play, he takes in hand all the cards of that player.

willy_the_kid.title: WILLY THE KID
willy_the_kid.desc: He can play any number of BANG! cards.

sheriff.title: SHERIFF
sheriff.desc: Kill all the Outlaws and the Renegade!

renegade.title: RENEGADE
renegade.desc: Be the last one in play!

deputy.title: DEPUTY
deputy.desc: Protect the Sheriff! Kill all the Outlaws and the Renegade!
